lines.zh: 下界配色的鳞，走在光里很暗。
lines.en: Nether colors on my scales. Dark in daylight.
Half a step behind you.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收着，不挡你的路。
lines.en: Wings folded. Not in your way.

lines.zh: 爪子落地的时候，沙会亮一下。
lines.en: When my claws land, the sand sparks.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，比看起来重。
lines.en: Steady. Heavier than I look.
You stop. I stop and look at you.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的外侧走，替你挡着。
lines.en: I hug your outer side and shield you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过地面，带着热气。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the ground. Heat with it.

lines.zh: 我从下界回来，还带着烟味。
lines.en: Back from the Nether. Still smelling of smoke.
I follow without asking where.

lines.zh: 我的脖子上有一道旧伤。
lines.en: An old scar on my neck.
Step by step, keeping pace with you.

lines.zh: 我们走过的路，地上有焦痕。
lines.en: A scorch trail where we've walked.
I go where you point.

lines.zh: 我伏在你旁边，翅膀遮着。
lines.en: I lie beside you, wings draped.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里有一点火，收着。
lines.en: A little fire in my throat. Held back.

lines.zh: 这具身体是在下界孵出来的。
lines.en: This body hatched in the Nether.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边打了个哈欠。
lines.en: I yawn at your feet.
Blackened marks on my scales.
Touch my back. The scales are warm.
I hold this side. You take that one.
I blink slowly. At ease.

lines.zh: 地上的灰被我翅膀扇开。
lines.en: My wings push the ash away.

lines.zh: 我记得破壳的时候，很热。
lines.en: I remember hatching. It was hot.
I don't call out. Might startle something.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上来回刮。
lines.en: My claws rake the ground.

lines.zh: 我在你身后，一直看得见你。
lines.en: Behind you. Always in sight.
A Nether egg taught me patience.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，眼睛是暗红的。
lines.en: I look up. Dark red eyes.

lines.zh: 你抬一下下巴，我就起步。
lines.en: One tilt of your chin and I move.
Nether ash clings to your cloak.
I lean in and nuzzle your hand.

lines.zh: 你的脸在火光里很好看。
lines.en: Your face looks good in firelight.

lines.zh: 我这样看着，是在等你说话。
lines.en: I watch like this, waiting for you to speak.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀可以把你整个盖住。
lines.en: My wings could cover all of you.

lines.zh: 你往哪走，我的爪子就往哪。
lines.en: Where your feet go, my claws go.

lines.zh: 你笑了，我喉咙里的火就小了。
lines.en: You smile and the fire in my throat quiets.

lines.zh: 我把头放低，靠在你肩上。
lines.en: I lower my head onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我记得那个遗迹里的冷。
lines.en: I remember the cold in those ruins.
You and me. Only us.
I look up. Your call.

lines.zh: 你身上的伤，我闻得出来。
lines.en: I can smell the wound on you.
I wait for a gesture from you.

lines.zh: 你开口，我耳朵就转过去。
lines.en: When you speak, my ears turn.
Half a step back. Scales clicking.
That one carried weight.
I fold my wings over the wound.
A scale came off. Ugly.
I didn't cry out. Don't worry.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的火弱了一点。
lines.en: The fire in my throat dimmed.
I'm still standing. Still in front.
I'll remember that one.
Give me a moment.
I can take this.
Meat. Pass the meat over.
That piece. Still warm.
I lower my head to your hand.
I won't snatch. I'll wait for you to set it down.
This tastes good.
Eat a little yourself.
One more and I'm full.
I ate fast. Sorry.
Nothing like this in the Nether.
I lick my lips. Want more.
I turn aside and open the path.
One bump. I'm fine.

lines.zh: 我的鳞是热的，你手会缩。
lines.en: My scales are hot. Your hand will pull back.
I turn slowly, for you.
Mind my tail. It has spines.
This close. I don't mind.

lines.zh: 你撞过来的地方，有点烫。
lines.en: Where you bumped me. A little hot.
Half a step back. Back to your side.
If you're climbing up, use my foreleg.
I'm guarding you. I won't bump you.
My life follows you.

lines.zh: 下界孵出来的，只认一个。
lines.en: Hatched in the Nether. I know only one.

lines.zh: 下界火焰里只有一个你。
lines.en: Only one of you in all that flame.

lines.zh: 你摸我的脖子，我就低下来。
lines.en: Touch my neck and I lower it.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀能把我们盖在一起。
lines.en: My wings could cover us both.

lines.zh: 你的每句话我压在鳞下。
lines.en: I keep your words under my scales.
Don't wander too far.
I sleep at your feet. Not leaving.

lines.zh: 诡异菌的味道，我从小闻惯了。
lines.en: I grew up on the smell of warped fungus.
I'm here. Always.
I carry it to your feet.
This one's for you.
I sniffed it. Iron.
More here. Let me get it.
Hot. I shake my claw.
I hold it gently.
Yours. Brought it back.
This smells of the Nether.
I hold it up for you to take.
A bit heavy. I drag it.
The air behind you warmed.
I'm in front of you.
Wings spread. Guarding behind.

lines.zh: 风从那边过来，带着锈味。
lines.en: Wind from there. Tastes of rust.
I go first. Don't follow.
Fire gathers in my throat.
I stand before your shadow.

lines.zh: 这块岩地我踩过很多次。
lines.en: I've crossed this rock many times.
It shouldn't be here.
Target already locked.
Get behind me. Quickly.
I can reach that.
I flatten. Tail drawn in.
Behind me. Keep quiet.

lines.zh: 我在下界孵出来，鳞是蓝的。
lines.en: Hatched in the Nether, my scales are blue.
It gives a block. I take one.
My scales are tightening.
The fire in my throat grows hotter.
I shift to your other side.
It's measuring too. I know.
Claws are in the soil.
It fears fire. It must.
No retreat here.
Its breathing quickened.
The fire in my throat is steady.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在热风里张开了。
lines.en: My scales flare in the hot wind.
Not one more step from it.
It looked down. Now.
This far. Not past this line.

lines.zh: 我从侧面切进去，先咬腿。
lines.en: I cut in from the side. Legs first.
A burst of fire on it.
Teeth sunk into its neck.

lines.zh: 这一下把它撞到岩壁上。
lines.en: That rammed it into the wall.

lines.zh: 我一爪按下去，火星四溅。
lines.en: I press a claw down; sparks fly.

lines.zh: 它打了我一下，鳞上有痕。
lines.en: It hit me. A mark on my scales.
I pin it. Claws stay.
It fled. I look back at you.
That was everything.
It's trying to get up.
I force it down again.
It fell back. You haven't moved.
Don't watch me. Watch it.
It stopped. I look back.
The shell broke and smoke poured out.

lines.zh: 这身颜色是在那边染上的。
lines.en: These colors were dyed on over there.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，脚下还在冒烟。
lines.en: I land. Still smoking underfoot.
I remember Dragon's Hand stone.
You reached out. I came.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀第一次张开，很宽。
lines.en: First spread of my wings. Wide.
The air here is thinner than the Nether.
I look up and learn your scent first.
I steady myself, then look at you.
I follow you from today.

lines.zh: 我在蛋里就听着外面的声音。
lines.en: In the shell I listened to the outside.

lines.zh: 火从我的鼻孔里出来一点。
lines.en: A little fire from my nostrils.

lines.zh: 我的鳞还在发亮，新孵的。
lines.en: My scales still shine. Newly hatched.
I chose you. Won't change.
You smiled. I lowered my head.
My first step. I stumbled.

lines.zh: 我的鳞上还有蛋壳的碎片。
lines.en: Shell fragments still on my scales.

lines.zh: 我站起来的动作还很生硬。
lines.en: My first stand was stiff.
Fire doesn't scare me. Scales shine brighter.
Fell. Wings didn't catch.
The water's cold. I dislike it.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀开，我滚了一圈。
lines.en: The blast threw me. I rolled.
My wing bone was pierced.

lines.zh: 这东西绕过鳞片进来了。
lines.en: It went around my scales.
Long hungry. Weak wings.
Lightning on my back. I growled.
Falling, still scenting for you.
